from.description: Return only entries recorded at or after this time.

to.description: Return only entries recorded strictly before this time.

action.description: Return only entries whose `action` equals this value.

actor.description: Return only entries whose `actor` DID equals this value. Matches on the plaintext; redacted entries are not returned by an actor filter.

outcome.description: Return only entries whose `outcome` equals this value.

contextId.description: Return only entries in this trust context.

limit.description: The most entries to return; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue. Encodes the position to resume from; a maintainer SHOULD sign it so it cannot be forged to skip entries. Treated as invalid (see errorCodes) if it fails to verify — e.g. minted before an audit-key rotation. A consumer that supplies a `cursor` MUST NOT also change the filters, which are bound into the cursor's position.

entries.description: The matching audit entries, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the next page, sent back as the request's `cursor`. Present iff more entries match beyond this page; absent on the last page.
